claim: On the ten-conversation LoCoMo evaluation set, complete conversation-built Entity-Memory retrieval improves official evidence recall over a matched dense Memory control across preregistered top-k values 5, 10, 25, and 50, while no overall final-answer F1 advantage is established.
limitations: The evidence covers one ten-conversation LoCoMo dataset and does not establish cross-dataset generalization.
Overall final-answer F1 differences between complete B and matched A are not statistically supported.
The official DRAGON reproduction gate failed; the local DRAGON condition is diagnostic only.
Monetary cost is not reported because provider pricing was not frozen.
The answer provider did not return a separately recorded actual-model identity in the formal snapshots; the requested model was gpt-3.5-turbo.
Category 5 retains the frozen upstream unseeded option-order behavior.
Cold/warm latency was measured on one machine and one provider endpoint.
